tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List published MojaLab blog posts (title, slug, excerpt, tags, date). Paginated; optionally filter by tag slug.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Get the full content of a published MojaLab blog post as Markdown, by slug.

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search published MojaLab posts by keyword (matches title and body text).

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List all public tags on MojaLab with their post counts.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List published static pages on MojaLab (about, tools, ...).

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Get the full content of a published MojaLab static page as Markdown, by slug.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_posts, get_post, search_posts, list_tags · Public sink: get_post, list_tags.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_posts, get_post, search_posts, list_tags · Public sink: get_post, list_tags

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
